about.intro: One Plus for Training and Development is a specialist in training, development, and consulting. We offer in-person and online programs to empower individuals and support companies through practical solutions that turn knowledge into measurable results.
about.whoWeAreText: We believe that effective training goes beyond information—it makes a difference in performance, behavior, and results. That's why we design our programs and workshops in a practical, applied way, and deliver them in-person and online to suit the learner's time and the organization's needs.
about.visionText: To be a trusted choice for training and development, and to create a tangible impact on individuals' paths and organizations' growth.
about.missionText: To deliver high-quality training programs, workshops, and consultations, based on real needs, with a clear methodology and practical application that directly reflects on work.
about.value1Desc: Clear standards and consistent quality in content and delivery.
about.value2Desc: Applicable training, with exercises and tools that support implementation.
about.value3Desc: In-person and online, with paths that suit different levels.
about.value4Desc: We understand the goal and build the solution with the client or learner.
about.value5Desc: We focus on real, observable and measurable results.
about.offer1Desc: Structured paths to build skills step by step.
about.offer2Desc: Applied workshops focused on tools, practice, and practical solutions.
about.offer3Desc: Assessing needs and building an individual or organizational development plan.
about.forIndividualsText: Skill development, career advancement, performance improvement, or building a new path with confidence.
about.forCompaniesText: Team capability building, in-house programs, custom workshops, and training solutions based on business needs.
about.why1: In-person and online programs with flexibility for everyone
about.why2: Practical content focused on application, not just theory
about.why5: Organized training experience from registration to follow-up
about.teamText: We work with a team of experts, trainers, and professionals to ensure a high-quality training experience.
about.finalCtaText: Share your goal and we'll suggest the right course or track for your level and schedule—in-person or online.

faq.heroDesc: Quick answers to the most common questions about courses, tracks, training format, and booking.
faq.section1Q1: What is the difference between a course and a training track?
faq.section1A1: A course focuses on a specific topic over a set period. A track is a sequence of courses that take you from basics to advanced level.
faq.section1Q2: Is the training suitable for beginners?
faq.section1A2: Yes. We offer different levels (beginner/intermediate/advanced). You can choose the right level or contact us for a recommendation.
faq.section1Q3: Do you offer in-person and online training?
faq.section1A3: Yes, we offer both in-person and online training depending on the program and schedule.
faq.section2Q1: How can I register for a course?
faq.section2A1: From the course detail page, choose (Book now / Register interest) or contact us directly and we'll guide you through the steps.
faq.section2Q2: Can I book a course for a group?
faq.section2A2: Yes, you can register as a group or request a custom program for your company team.
faq.section2Q3: Are there fixed dates or on-demand?
faq.section2A3: Some courses have scheduled dates; others are offered on demand (especially for companies). Contact us to see what's available.
faq.section3Q1: Is there hands-on practice during the course?
faq.section3A1: Yes, we focus on application, exercises, and tools that help you implement what you learn.
faq.section3A2: It depends on the program. When a certificate is available, it's stated on the course page; you can confirm with us before registering.
faq.section3A3: Usually yes (files, templates, references) depending on the course.
faq.section4Q1: Do you offer custom programs for companies?
faq.section4A1: Yes. We design training programs and in-house workshops based on your team's needs, sector, and duration.
faq.section4Q2: How do you determine the right program for a company?
faq.section4A2: We start by understanding your goals, challenges, and number of participants, then propose a training plan with clear modules.
faq.section4Q3: Can training be delivered in-person at our office or online?
faq.section4A3: Yes, we offer both options depending on your preference and the nature of the training.
faq.section5A1: Individual or organizational sessions to assess needs and build a clear development plan, with optional follow-up as agreed.
faq.section5Q2: How do I book a consultation?
faq.section5A2: On the contact page, choose "Consultation" as the request type, or contact us directly and we'll coordinate with you.
faq.ctaDesc: Contact us and we'll get back to you as soon as possible.

User: Any person who browses the site, registers, or communicates through it.
Services: Courses, training tracks, workshops, consultations, and any content delivered via the site in-person or online.
terms.s3Content:
Users must use the site for lawful purposes only.
Abuse of forms or sending offensive or misleading content is prohibited.
We reserve the right to suspend or block access in case of violations or misuse.
terms.s4Content:
Registration may require accurate, up-to-date information (name, phone, email, etc.).
The user is responsible for the accuracy of data and any consequences of inaccurate information.

terms.s5Content:

Prices may vary by training format (in-person/online) or by offers and discounts.

terms.s10Content:

privacy.heroDesc: How we collect, use, and protect your data when you use the One Plus Training & Development website.
privacy.s1Content: This privacy policy explains how we collect, use, and protect personal data when you use the One Plus Training & Development website or when you register or contact us. By using the site, you agree to this policy.
privacy.s2Content:
We may collect the following data depending on how you use the site:
Identity data: name, phone number, email.
Request data: type of service (course/track/consultation/corporate training), training format (in-person/online), your message or inquiry.
Technical data: IP address, browser type, device, pages visited, and cookie data when enabled.
privacy.s3Content:
We use your data for:
Responding to your inquiries and providing support.
Managing registration, booking, and communication about courses, workshops, and consultations.
Improving the site experience, content, and services.
Sending updates or offers (only with your consent or where permitted by law).
Complying with legal and regulatory requirements when necessary.
privacy.s4Content:
We process your data based on one or more of:
Your consent when filling forms or opting in to receive messages.
Performance of a service you requested (e.g. course registration or consultation request).
Legitimate interest in improving the service and user experience.
Legal obligations when required.
privacy.s5Content:
We do not sell your personal data. We may share some data in a limited way with:
Technical service providers (hosting, email, contact forms, analytics) as needed to run the site.
Payment providers (if any) to complete transactions.
Official bodies when required by law.
We ensure third parties have appropriate data protection.
privacy.s6Content: We may use cookies to improve user experience and measure performance. You can control cookies in your browser settings. Disabling them may affect some site features.
privacy.s7Content: We take appropriate organizational and technical measures to protect data from unauthorized access, use, modification, or loss. However, no internet transmission can be guaranteed 100% secure.
privacy.s8Content: We keep your data for as long as needed for the purposes in this policy or to meet legal/regulatory requirements, then delete or anonymize it when no longer needed.
privacy.s9Content:
You may have the right to:
Request access to or correction of your data.
Request deletion of your data (where permitted by law).
Object to or request restriction of certain processing.
Withdraw consent for marketing messages at any time.
privacy.s10Content: Our services are aimed at adults. If you believe a child has provided us with data without parental consent, please contact us to have it removed.
privacy.s11Content: The site may contain links to other websites. We are not responsible for their privacy policies.
privacy.s12Content: We may update this privacy policy from time to time. The updated version will be posted on this page, and continued use of the site constitutes acceptance of the updates.
privacy.s13Content: For any privacy-related inquiries or requests about your data, contact us via our Contact page.
